subject: bulk properties for SPAM in mixed solvents

messages.author: David Poole
messages.body:
Hello everyone,
It occurred to me that spam(tm) is a mixed meat.. and while others have
considered SPAM to study interactions with mixed solvents (i.e.,
acetonitrile-water), I don't find a 'standard' protocol for parameterizing
bulk values needed for the equation. Is this possible, and how should it be
handled in the code?
Kindly,
David
